title: Training Notes: Grievance Filings and Prior Authorization Extension Units
content:
The units a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension adds carry a grievance addition that counts the member's Appeals and Grievances cases filed in the three months before the day of the extension.

## Rule

- A Quality of Care Grievance filed in those three months: **2 units** are added.
- No Quality of Care Grievance, but a Member Grievance filed in those three months: **1 unit** is added.
- Otherwise: nothing is added.

The addition is made once to the units the extension adds, before the floor of zero and the ceiling of the class's extension allotment are applied.

## Questions and answers

**The member filed both a Quality of Care Grievance and a Member Grievance in the three months. What is added?** A Quality of Care Grievance was filed, so 2 units; the Member Grievance adds nothing further.

**Does it matter whether the grievance is still open?** The rule counts grievances by the date they were filed in the three months before the day of the extension; it does not look at the case's status.

**The only Member Grievance was filed four months before the extension. What is added?** It falls outside the three months, so nothing is added.

**The member has only a Standard Appeal filed last month. What is added?** A Standard Appeal is neither a Quality of Care Grievance nor a Member Grievance, so nothing is added.
